title: Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></p> <p>The Cities team leads the work necessary to implement the regulatory products and processes needed globally to comply with regulations, and does so in a manner that also sustainably supports Airbnb's growth.</p> <p>Within Cities, this role owns Airbnb's platform regulatory compliance program across EMEA — the growing set of EU and UK obligations that sit alongside, and increasingly beyond, short-term rental regulation.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></p> <p>As Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA, you are the accountable owner for a portfolio of platform regulations that is expanding in scope, scrutiny, and consequence — including the Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act, and more.</p> <p>You will translate each obligation into a durable operating process, a defensible reporting methodology, or a product change — and serve as a trusted advisor to Legal, Policy, and Product leadership on how Airbnb meets its regulatory commitments in the region.</p> <p><strong>A Typical Day: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the EMEA compliance portfolio.</strong> Establish the operating processes and documentation that sustain obligations at scale, and report and monitor status and risk.</li> <li><strong>Deliver regulatory reporting and submissions.</strong> Own the annual and ad hoc reporting calendar end to end. Deliver against regulatory deadlines, and iterate so each cycle is faster and more defensible than the last.</li> <li><strong>Assess obligations and strengthen assurance.</strong> Identify new and changing obligations early, evaluate our readiness against them, and recommend the measures required to meet them. </li> <li><strong>Translate regulatory requirements into scalable solutions. </strong>Define the product, engineering, and data requirements needed to meet obligations at scale, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap, sequence delivery, and validate outcomes against compliance standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise: </strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, compliance program management, or regulatory operations — preferably in a technology platform or another highly regulated industry.</li> <li>Proven track record owning a multi-jurisdiction, cross-functional compliance program end to end, with direct experience across the Digital Services Act, and the UK Online Safety Act. </li> <li>Hands-on experience with a recurring regulator-facing reporting cycle and the relationship management that comes with it.</li> <li>Track record partnering with Product and Engineering to deliver regulatory requirements into live products.</li> <li>Data fluency to define, own, and defend a reporting methodology to auditors and regulators.</li> <li>Familiarity with regulatory technology and automation tools.</li> <li>Ability to operate with a strategic lens—connecting regulatory requirements to long-term business objectives and functional roadmaps.</li> <li>Excellent communicator and negotiator; able to transform ambiguity into clarity, and move from complexity to consensus.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and an ability to design operational structures that balance compliance, risk, and scalability.</li> <li>Proven leadership growing and coaching high-performing, diverse teams; comfortable leading through influence as well as structure.</li> </ul> <p><strong style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£122,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£152,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Analyst (MMM)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>Gain Theory is part of<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http:/wpp.com/__;!!IfJP2Nwhk5Z0yJ43lA!L_cfT4E3gsmmDY1lVQTB6ihlfPeBl9X4sMM2KI6iWZYexC2nCeZ9oxgP9qvgbrqxIBpx82rGb_mWqh5F0zKxq5_dP7Y$" data-outlook-id="5677231c-455b-4705-9250-42d6515234fb">WPP</a>, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p></div><h2>The opportunity:</h2> <p>You will support senior colleagues in achieving the efficient delivery of client projects. Typical responsibilities and duties are the collection and preparation of data, contributing to the finalisation of models, writing results and implications and SFX creation.</p> <p>Your role as Principal Analyst is to take responsibility for and oversee other analysts. You will also be expected support the development of analysts through the Training Academy, Knowledge Shares and feedback. Principal Analysts should develop relationships with their counterparts client side and be able to communicate Gain Theory approaches and brand beliefs.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing:</h2> <p><strong><em>Working with data:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Data extraction and manipulation, data analysis and validation, batch files, programming</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Undertake data extraction, manipulation, and data analysis to understand the marketplace and client context relevant to each project.</em></li> <li><em>Analyse all datasets to ensure that each KPI is understood and can be explained back to the team.</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that all tables, charts and other information produced by you, or others has been checked for accuracy and formatted to GT standards before passing on to senior project team.</em></li> <li><em>Be responsible for data collection including preparation and sending of data requests, chasing outstanding data and querying data with clients and agencies.</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that ROVA input files are structured to meet requirements of project (e.g. order and number of variables, exclusion of unnecessary variables)</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that all outputs are checked for accuracy by analysts; record any checks made.</em></li> <li><em>Proficiency in using data extraction tools (i.e. Advantage, AdDynamix, Sysomos, Google Trends, Google Analytics, Double Click) and able to teach others in their use. Be aware of alternatives and the PROs / CONs of the tool.</em></li> <li><em>Proficiency in using Excel/SQL/Python/Pandas/Analytics Workbench to process, transform, create variables and build models. Be or be working towards expert knowledge in a selection of these tools / approaches.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Building Models:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Model building and validation, sales effects calculations, ROIs, media optimisation</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Oversee the building of comprehensive base models according to the project specification, incorporating all drivers of KPIs, providing rationale for variables entered, understanding coefficients and SFX.</em></li> <li><em>Taking base models, oversee or build in additional improvements and progress the model towards finalization.</em></li> <li><em>Calculate sales effects throughout the project to check results and assess their correctness, i.e. does media contribution make sense? Report to project team on preliminary findings and observations</em></li> <li><em>Create sales effect/ ROI workbook, ensure it is easy to follow and all links are correct.</em></li> <li><em>Create response curves and optimisation spreadsheets or alternatively use available tools for budget allocation. Run scenarios required to answer client objectives.</em></li> <li><em>Validate models, identify areas of weakness, suggest and test possible improvements and ensure robustness and validity.</em></li> </ul> <p><em>.</em><strong><em>Creation of presentations:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Content creation, summary of findings, accuracy checks</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Create content as specified by project lead, taking responsibility for entire sections rather than focusing on just factual and data slides.</em></li> <li><em>Assist in the creation of all areas of the deck as directed.</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that all content is checked for accuracy and that it is correctly labelled, complete and ready for delivery to client.</em></li> <li><em>Summarise and comment on findings, add consultancy input rather than on factual statements.</em></li> <li><em>Be able to explain and justify any potential changes that need to be made to provide sensible results. Especially important when reviewing others’ outputs that you are overseeing.</em></li> </ul> <p><em> </em><strong><em>Client Relationship Management & Interaction:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Client contact and interaction, delivery of results to the client</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Answer specific data questions that may arise in external meetings as the lead analyst; act as a specialist closest to the data.</em></li> <li><em>Be prepared to lead calls with clients (data calls, weekly calls etc.).</em></li> <li><em>Be involved in the delivery of results to the client and present sections of presentations during meetings.</em></li> <li><em>Take charge of day-to-day client contact using email and telephone where appropriate.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong><em> </em></strong><strong><em>Interpretation of results:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Result interpretation and rationale, recommendations, translation of results from analytics into actionable recommendations</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Provide input into the results and implications and comment on the interpretation for future strategies.</em></li> <li><em>Interpret results and understand the implications of these results to the client. Be able to explain your interpretation to the team and defend your POV.</em></li> <li><em>Be able to explain and justify any potential changes that need to be made to provide sensible results. Especially important when reviewing others’ outputs that you are overseeing.</em></li> </ul> <p><em> </em><strong><em>Team Support & Development:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Team collaboration, leadership, communication</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Motivate and inspire team members by ensuring that excellent performance is acknowledged and reasons for success are shared amongst the team.</em></li> <li><em>Take responsibility for supervising, supporting and training junior team members.</em></li> <li><em>Take responsibility for training new joiners including project managing Graduate Analysts during their training project.</em></li> <li><em>Lead by behaving in a way that reinforces values and goals of Gain Theory to all employees.</em></li> <li><em>Assist team members in interpreting the tasks they have been set.</em></li> <li><em>Provide timely feedback to team members.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Innovation:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Process improvements, product development, new trainings</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Actively seek more efficient ways of doing things for yourself and others and turn suggestions into actions.</em></li> <li><em>Host knowledge shares to share your experience on topics of interest for the business.</em></li> <li><em>Be proactive in using new tools and take the active part in their testing when in the development stage, in line with your personal expertise and skills.</em></li> <li><em>Assist in service and product development, where necessary. title: Quality Assurance Manager
description: PHMG works with more than 36,000 clients across the globe – and we're committed to delivering the very best service to every single one. This dedication to has led to the rapid expansion of our client care teams, as we continue to expand our impact, we are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Quality Assurance Manager. As a Quality Assurance Manager, you will assist in the management of the quality assurance team providing coaching, leadership and guidance, whilst also overseeing the development and delivery of a robust internal audit function that delivers value and best practice to the internal governance of the business. The Quality Assurance Team play a crucial role within the Client Services department. You will be responsible for reviewing all engagement with our client base, reporting effectively on processes, analysing the data and trends to ensure that quality standards are consistently met across projects and departments and identifying and implementing relevant process improvements. Salary: £34,000 base (£39,000 OTE) Location: Old Trafford, Manchester Hours: Monday to Friday 8.45am to 5.15pm Job Role As a Quality Assurance Manager, you will oversee the development and delivery of a robust internal audit function that delivers value and best practice to the internal governance of the business. The Quality Assurance Team play a crucial role within the Client Services department. description: Location: Remote First; office location Moorgate, London (flexible remote working locations within UK/Europe) Employment type: Permanent Working Hours: Full-time (9-6 UK) Salary: Up to £120,000 + Shares + Benefits TransFICC is hiring a Network Infrastructure Engineer to provide high-performance, low-latency connectivity to our customers. title: Senior Specialist, QA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Overview of Role:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335557856":16777215,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. The work translates business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into actionable decisions. The role You'll model expected customer take-up rates, design experiments, and translate findings into pricing and product decisions for the acquisition channel that drives the most customer lifetime value (CLTV). Because the Broker Terms team is a young team, you'll influence how its analytical approach develops, not just what it produces. The work has direct commercial consequences: brokers act on what the team builds and tests, and that shapes which customers iwoca wins and on what terms. Offer terms and experimentation. You'll model how customers respond to offer terms and how brokers make decisions under uncertainty. You'll design experiments where causal inference is central: you'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. Commercial translation. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and see your analysis applied directly in day-to-day decisions. That includes meeting brokers in person – gaining context that shapes how you frame and interpret results – and coordinating with adjacent teams responsible for underwriting decisions, repeat lending, and offer construction. CLTV and customer journey. You'll think across the full broker-referred customer journey – from first funding to repeat – identifying what drives CLTV and what changes to offer terms or UX improve it. You own both the strategy and the mechanism, so your findings feed directly into what the team builds and tests. AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work – not occasionally, but as a default. You should have a view on where it genuinely helps and where a different approach is better. The requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work. Causal inference and experimentation. You have experience with careful experimental design to facilitate clean, trustworthy results. Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it. Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries (pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyMC). AI leverage. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles. Bonus: Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them to commercial stakeholders. Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling. Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services. title: Research Analyst
description: About BeInCrypto BeInCrypto is a part of the media group BeInNews Ltd, a global newsroom and research team covering institutional finance and digital assets as they intersect: regulation, trading infrastructure, and market structure - backed by original data and a team reporting from every major time zone. Our 100+ journalists and analysts operate across 50+ countries, publishing in 26 languages. We are official media partners at Money20/20, Digital Assets Forum London, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049, Proof of Talk, and other leading industry events. About the role We are seeking a hands-on Research Analyst to develop and deliver high-quality institutional research at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets. You will take ownership of the research process, from identifying relevant topics and analysing data to producing insightful, accurate, and publication-ready reports. What you’ll do: Own the end-to-end research process, from identifying relevant topics and developing research angles to data analysis, report writing, and final quality control. Produce clear, insightful, institutional-grade research reports covering traditional finance, digital assets, market trends, and emerging opportunities. Critically evaluate data, challenge assumptions, identify inconsistencies, and ensure the accuracy and credibility of research findings, including AI-generated content. Identify relevant industry trends, research opportunities, and insights that resonate with institutional audiences. Collaborate with editorial, product, design, and commercial teams to develop valuable research products, including reports, indices, and premium research offerings. Engage with industry experts and data providers when needed to gather insights, validate findings, and strengthen research quality. You are the perfect match if you: Have proven hands-on experience in traditional finance research, financial journalism, or market intelligence, ideally with exposure to digital assets. Have experience working at an established financial research firm, financial institution, market intelligence provider, or leading financial media outlet. Can independently manage research projects from initial analysis to a complete, publication-ready report. Have strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, challenge conclusions, and develop original insights. Can produce well-structured, accurate, and engaging research reports in fluent English. Are confident working with financial data, research platforms, and AI tools while independently validating and improving their outputs. Understand institutional financial markets and can identify research topics relevant to professional audiences. Have a product mindset and understand how high-quality research can create value for audiences and support commercial opportunities. What we offer to you: 100% remote work with no location restrictions. Flexible working hours with no time tracking and no mandatory meetings outside your timezone. Paid time off to recharge. Direct collaboration with the CEO and executive leadership on research strategy and institutional initiatives. Access to leading data platforms and research tools, among which are Glassnode, CryptoQuant, Messari, DelphiDigital, LunarCrush, Nansen, Santiment, Dune, and others. Opportunities to build your personal brand through speaking engagements, podcasts, conferences, and media appearances. Access to major crypto and fintech events around the world. Internal learning programs, masterclasses, and knowledge sharing. Clear goals, measurable outcomes, and a data-driven culture where your work has a visible business impact. An inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, nationality, gender, identity, abilities, or beliefs, can thrive. Meet our team: You’ll be working with the Multimedia Global Newsroom team. Your manager will be Chief Global Strategy Officer. This team is the heart of BeInCrypto - reporting and original research on digital assets and institutional finance, published in 26 languages. Ready to start your new journey with us? At BIC, we value your ideas, curiosity, dynamism, adaptability, ownership mindset, passion for innovation and AI, awareness of industry trends, and ability to work autonomously and stay organized. If this approach resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team and achieve new heights together! Recruitment process: Portfolio review → HR interview → Take-home assignment → Interview with our Managing Editor and Chief Global Strategy Officer → Offer. Apply now, and our Recruitment team will contact you with the next steps. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Technical Data Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span><br>As a <strong>Team Lead, Technical Data Analyst </strong>you will serve as a player-coach - guiding a team of analysts while also executing complex data work yourself. At this level, you are developing your people management skills while leveraging your product, industry, and technical knowledge to advance. You will be the technical anchor for your team, providing the daily guidance needed to navigate complex data challenges and meet project deadlines. You take the vision set by leadership and turn it into reality, ensuring the team stays aligned with our core processes. Your focus is on problem-solving and technical steering, acting as the first line of support to ensure your team's success. This role focused on the functional coaching and project delivery.</p> <p>Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to the team within the technical data function</li> <li>Execute hands-on contribution to projects through data migration and data transformation using Python-based ETL tools.</li> <li>Manage the team’s work allocation and coordinate activities to ensure results are driven by the team in collaboration with others.</li> <li>Guide the team in issue resolution and escalate blockers proactively, maintaining alignment with stakeholders.</li> <li>Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution</li> <li>Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater efficiency.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Experience: 2+ years of related experience and a Bachelor’s degree, or 2+ years and a Master’s degree.</li> <li><strong>Domain Knowledge:</strong> Strong understanding of portfolio, wealth, or investment management and financial data structures.</li> <li><strong>Technical Skills:</strong> Proficient in Python and knowledgeable in ETL workflows and data transformation logic.</li> <li><strong>Communication</strong>: Strong communication skills, able to conduct technical presentations and convey complex ideas clearly.</li> <li><strong>Organization</strong>: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to coordinate activities and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs.</li> <li><strong>Mindset</strong>: Solutions-driven mindset with a desire to improve processes and a commitment to personal growth in people management</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Our Values </strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.</span></li> <li><strong>Build Together - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. </span></li> <li><strong>Champion Our Clients - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. </span></li> <li><strong>Drive Innovation - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. </span></li> <li><strong>Embrace Learning - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. </span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. description: <p><strong>Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Content Marketing Manager on the Marketing team in our London office, you will take ownership of key content initiatives, craft our product narrative, and protect our brand tone of voice across global touchpoints.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Head of Global Brand and Marketing Communications, you will serve as the central content strategist and owner for our flagship products. As an Individual Contributor (IC), you will leverage strong cross functional relationships  partnering closely with writers, designers, web managers, social media leads, and customer engagement teams to deliver high impact, conversion focused content campaigns.</p> <p><strong>To thrive in this role, you’ll need: </strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in content marketing within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.</li> <li>High comfort level working as a hands on, high impact Individual Contributor (IC) who drives alignment across matrixed teams without needing direct reports.</li> <li>To be based in the UK and willing to work on a hybrid schedule (3 days in office per week).</li> <li>Proven track record in crafting high level product messaging frameworks, long form hero content, and conversion driven microcopy.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with demonstrated ability to manage creative agencies, external vendors, and cross departmental teams.</li> <li>Familiarity with digital content metrics, web analytics, and campaign measurement tools to optimize content based on data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience and qualifcations in Editing / Journalism / Writing<strong><br></strong></li> <li>Experience in the AdTech industry </li> </ul> <p><strong>How you’ll make an impact: </strong></p> <p>As a Senior Content Marketing Manager, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Product Messaging & Positioning: Own core messaging frameworks for leading products, translating complex value propositions into clear, compelling stories across all customer lifecycle stages.</li> <li>Brand Tone of Voice & Microcopy: Serve as the custodian of our Brand Tone of Voice. Write and refine microcopy across website UI, landing pages, CTAs, and email touchpoints to elevate user experience and drive conversion.</li> <li>Campaign & Project Ownership<strong>:</strong> End to end ownership of major content marketing projects  from strategy and brief creation to cross functional alignment, execution, and performance measurement.</li> <li>Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal content writers, designers, web managers, social media, and customer engagement teams to execute cohesive, multi channel content strategies.</li> <li>Vendor & Agency Management: Lead relationships with external agencies, freelance writers, and external vendors to scale content output while ensuring high standards of brand quality and tone.</li> <li>Performance Analysis: Monitor content KPIs and analytics to evaluate messaging impact, optimizing distribution and content performance over time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Taboola?</strong></p> <p>If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:</p> <ul> <li>Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.</li> <li><strong>Well-being:</strong> With an office culture that’s international, social and supportive, Taboola offers very generous benefits including 25 days holiday, excellent health insurance, some flexible working, free breakfast and lunch every day, stock options and Perkbox to name just a few.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility: </strong>We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.</li> <li><strong>Work with some of the biggest names: </strong>Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, Expedia and Honda.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ready to realize your potential?</strong></p> <p>Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.</p> <p>Learn more about #TaboolaLife on<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?fetchDeterministicClustersOnly=true&heroEntityKey=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A128707&keywords=taboola&origin=RICH_QUERY_SUGGESTION&position=2&searchId=dcc8bfbb-b05c-458e-a7f1-726d30e7dd80&sid=9(y&spellCorrectionEnabled=false"> LinkedIn</a>,<a href="https://www.facebook.com/taboola/"> Facebook</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/taboola.israel/?hl=en"> Instagram</a>,<a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BctKkw2Vj_EOjvy24kjRKq_ZxZzmZxweIqNLQgsLtcs/edit?tab=t.0"> X</a>,<a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6W0hdStO0jRVYhg4ABzjRw"> YouTube</a>, & the<a href="https://bit.ly/41kidx9"> Taboola Life Blog</a>.</p> <p><strong>About Taboola</strong></p> <p>Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.</p> <p>Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. title: Director, Head of Tax
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p></div><p><strong>Head of Tax – Fanatics International</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day—building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with limitless entrepreneurial spirit, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p> <p>As we continue to scale our global platform, the Head of Tax – Fanatics International will play a critical role in owning group-wide tax strategy, compliance, and risk governance across Fanatics International's Commerce, Collectibles (Topps), and Betting and Gaming divisions.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>This is a senior leadership role with group-wide responsibility for tax strategy, compliance, and risk governance across the Fanatics International group — spanning three business verticals (Commerce, Collectibles (Topps), and Betting and Gaming) and multiple legal entities operating across the UK, Europe, and international markets. VAT and indirect tax sit at the heart of this role; Fanatics International operates complex, high-volume supply chains across more than 30 VAT registrations globally, covering marketplace models, dropshipping arrangements, Importer of Record structures, and digital goods supplied to consumers across the UK, EU, and wider international markets. The Head of Tax – Fanatics International delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p><strong>HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <p>Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Team & Leadership Impact</strong> (Build Championship Teams)</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the CFO of International Commerce, President of International, Finance leadership, Legal, FP&A, and IT to embed tax considerations into commercial decision-making, ERP configuration, and financial reporting across all three Fanatics International business divisions.</li> <li>Manage and coordinate external adviser relationships — including Big 4 and specialist firms — ensuring timely, accurate, and risk-managed filings across all relevant jurisdictions while maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Act as the primary HMRC point of contact for the group, leading the compliance relationship across disputes, product classification claims, Bespoke Retail Scheme management, and Collectibles (Topps), and Betting and Gaming.</li> <li>Build a scalable tax function with robust governance frameworks, policies, and procedures covering intercompany pricing, VAT compliance, and Avalara, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 — ensuring accurate VAT determination at the point of transaction so fan purchases are processed correctly at scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Problem requirements into scalable, auditable system logic that keeps pace with Fanatics International's growth trajectory.</li> <li>Drive VAT structuring for complex cross-border arrangements including dropshipping, Importer of Record models, marketplace structures, and intercompany recharges — designing solutions that are both technically robust and commercially enabling.</li> <li>Lead all international tax technical analysis including treaty analysis, withholding tax assessments, and cross-border restructuring advisory, identifying opportunities to improve tax efficiency within a compliant framework.</li> <li>Develop and implement the Group's approach to emerging digital reporting obligations, including e-invoicing compliance across EU jurisdictions, anticipating regulatory Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. On a day-to-day basis, we work with engineers from partners organization to help them develop, test, certify, and launch partners direct-to-consumer (DTC) apps in compliance with the Roku platform distribution agreement. We represent partners’ roadmap and technical needs by working cross-functionally with the assigned Partner Engagement Managers, product and engineering teams within Roku.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">About the role</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":320,"335559739":140}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Roku's platform is live across the multiple European countries, and our European footprint is growing — through Roku TV licensing partners, through our own streaming hardware, and through the local broadcasters and streaming services that make the platform worth owning in each market.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will be the senior engineer for our European partners: the person who makes their apps fast, stable and certifiable on Roku, who represents their technical constraints to our platform and OS teams, and who makes each new market launch a technical success rather than a scramble.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will be the engineer for a portfolio of European partners — public service and commercial broadcasters, subscription streaming services and pay-TV operators — working with the Partner Engineering team in San Jose and with the Partner Engagement Manager in London who owns those partners’ relationships. marketing to build brand presence in a new market Proven experience self-sourcing pipeline through outbound prospecting and cold calling into Upmarket accounts Strong background in B2B SaaS, with title: Finance Forecasting Modeller
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. We’re looking for people who can bring clarity to complex technical programmes, influence across teams and help turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes for our customers.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of launching payment products that cross multiple teams and disciplines</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programs: <ul> <li>Define program roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers and speed up delivery</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience managing complex technology programs or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You are able to communicate clearly and persuasively to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership</li> <li>You are comfortable in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be a part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and identify/mitigate delivery risks proactively; can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data and architecture to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Regulatory Reporting Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰up to £55,000 (depending on experience) ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance | <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨ </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Regulatory team</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for<strong> </strong>a curious, adaptive and data-focused <strong>Regulatory Reporting Analyst</strong> with a strong attention to detail to join our regulatory reporting team at Monzo. The team is responsible for understanding our prudential regulatory reporting requirements, working on projects and submissions relating to these and collaborating with teams across Monzo.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Producing Monzo’s regulatory liquidity reporting, ensuring robust and consistent controls across all outputs to support regulatory compliance and internal governance requirements</li> <li>Documenting the applicable regulatory interpretations and communication</li> <li>Assisting the wider team produce Monzo’s capital and liquidity regulatory reporting and disclosures (including Pillar 3)</li> <li>Executing and improving the controls required to ensure regulatory reporting is timely, accurate and complete</li> <li>Ensuring all our regulatory reporting runs like clockwork</li> <li>Using data visualisation tools to build dashboards and facilitate sign-off and useful insights</li> <li>Designing brilliant ways to automate your work and leverage technology to ensure we scale with the business</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a good understanding and experience of producing LCR, NSFR, PRA110, ALMM returns</li> <li>You’re excited by data and have a sharp eye for detail</li> <li>You have knowledge of coding languages like SQL would be a bonus, although a willingness to learn is just fine </li> <li>You have a proven record of delivering to strict deadlines </li> <li>You want to automate or enhance recurring processes, particularly by leveraging technology, but know how to balance this with getting the actual reports out!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰up to £55,000 (depending on experience) ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office on a hybrid basis. We expect 1 - 2 days per week working from the office.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 £200 allowance to spend on your work-from-home setup after completing your first full month with us.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Initial call with hiring manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Technical interview with hiring manager and team member (45 mins)</li> <li>Monzo behavioural interview (30 min)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-NZ1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring for the <strong>Head of Financial Planning & Analysis</strong>, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team. You will play a key part leading our monthly business reviews and forecasting, annual planning, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment, as well as develop the long term roadmap for the FP&A team. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a proven record of leading a team to use data analysis to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.</p> <p>Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role in AMER or EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations</li> <li>Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment</li> <li>Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives</li> <li>Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence</li> <li>Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning</li> <li>Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting</li> <li>Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings</li> <li>Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team</li> <li>Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams</li> <li>Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record</li> <li>Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth </li> <li>Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities</li> <li>Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character</li> <li>Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects</li> <li>Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools</li> <li>Understanding of core accounting principles </li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments </li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience</li> <li>Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis</li> <li>Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based in our office in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> description: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London / UK | Salary dependent on experience + Stock Options + Benefits </p> <p>Flex is one of Monzo’s fastest-growing and most commercially significant products. Four years ago, we reinvented the credit card experience—building something simpler, more transparent, and genuinely useful. Today, over a million customers use Flex.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Director to lead Flex into its next phase of growth.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, deeply commercial role at the intersection of product and credit. You’ll define how we scale borrowing responsibly, expand into new segments, and continue building products customers genuinely love.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data, Design, and senior leadership to identify new opportunities, optimise performance across complex segments, and deliver at pace.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on… </strong></p> <p><strong>Set the strategy for Flex</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set direction for one of Monzo’s most important revenue-driving products</li> <li>Identify and unlock new commercial opportunities across customer segments</li> <li>Navigate complex trade-offs between growth, risk, and customer outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive commercial performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Credit teams to shape propositions across multiple risk segments and cohorts</li> <li>Interrogate performance deeply — from unit economics to long-term profitability curves</li> <li>Identify and drive new commercial opportunities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Champion the customer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure Flex remains rooted in strong customer outcomes, not just revenue</li> <li>Push for simple, transparent, and delightful experiences</li> <li>Advocate for customer experience alongside commercial outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build and lead a high-performing team</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage and develop a team of Product Managers</li> <li>Deliver multiple high-impact initiatives through your direct reports</li> <li>Raise the bar on product thinking and foster a culture of high standard and high velocity</li> </ul> <p><strong>🌟 What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial Thinking </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong commercial instinct — you think in terms of trade-offs, economics, and outcomes</li> <li>Comfortable operating in complex environments (e.g. multiple segments and cohorts with different commercials)</li> <li>Able to engage deeply with Credit and Data partners</li> <li>Experience in lending, credit cards, or adjacent borrowing products </li> </ul> <p><strong>Consumer Focus</strong></p> <ul> <li>You start with the customer never lose track of their needs</li> <li>You’re willing to challenge revenue-driven decisions when they conflict with good customer outcomes</li> <li>You have strong product taste and care deeply about experience quality</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & Leadership </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced environments with multiple workstreams</li> <li>Comfortable going deep in the detail while leading through others</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across technical, credit, and governance stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> <p><strong>#LI-AC1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK.
